messages:
incidentbot: PagerDuty page fired — service: embeddings-eu · severity: high
incidentbot: incident id INC-45832 · link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/INC45832
sophie: @incidentbot acked. I'm on it. :point_up:
raj: ack — standing by, pulling logs
sophie: quick metrics: error rate ≈ 37% (09:12–09:18 UTC), p95 latency 820ms; lots of 504s
elaine: support reports ~9 customers with degraded embeddings. I'm prepping a PSA.
sophie: running tail of inference nodes logs to see K/V cache behavior
```
[2024-09-12T09:13:05Z] embeddings-service eu-west - 504 gateway timeout - model: llama-13b-q4
[2024-09-12T09:13:06Z] KV_CACHE miss spike - ttl=0
[2024-09-12T09:13:07Z] worker-12 evicting keyset, freed=0
```
raj: looks like a kvcache eviction storm; autoscaler didn't spin up fast enough. Starting scale-up: `redwoodctl scale pool embeddings-eu --replicas 6`
sophie: adding temporary fallback route to cached-embeddings (lower accuracy) for critical customers: route id r_984. will mark in PD notes.
sophie: handoff note: I have a customer call in ~8m — raj, can you take ownership after I patch?
raj: taking over after the patch. will monitor and post status pings every 2m.
pagerbot: Escalation policy: notify @sre-senior if incident not mitigated within 10m — current status: acknowledged
raj: scale command finished, nodes provisioning. Watching warmup logs.
```
$ kubectl get pods -n inference | grep embeddings-eu
embeddings-eu-12345   Running   2/2   45s
embeddings-eu-12346   Running   2/2   40s
```
sophie: thanks. ETA for visible error reduction ~4–6m after warmup.
elaine: I'll open a support thread and DM the top 3 affected accounts with the preliminary timeline.
raj: error rate down to ~18% — continuing to monitor; will signal when stable.
sophie: I'm back from the call and will watch for the next 10m. If stable we remove fallback and start rollup.
raj: marking incident as 'under-mitigation' in PD and creating followup doc: https://redwood.internal/ops/incidents/INC-45832
incidentbot: Incident update: status=mitigating · owner=@raj · last_update=09:25 UTC
sophie: thanks team — will add a postmortem entry and runbook notes after resolution :memo:
elaine: PSA drafted, awaiting final metric snapshot before send.
raj: will update again in 5m; if metrics hold I'll prepare for handback to sophie for close.
